review: Actual world endpoint heuristic is admissible and consistent for the unchanged Euclidean graph edges. g-score stale skipping and popped-destination termination are correct. Queue ties deterministic by f,g,index. Default Dijkstra queue unchanged. No code blockers; graph optimum does not establish physical bearing.

poseReuseReview.rationale: Scoped to opt-in aStar and one invocation with shared source/descriptor/strand/solver inputs. Exact rotation and X/Z translation key covers pose-dependent physical inputs; Y is always re-solved from zero and camera/cache fields do not participate. Recursive reduction strictly reduces duplicate pose count, then deep-copies result into each original pose ID to avoid aliasing. No approximate symmetry or persistent stale cache.
